findings.issue: Tokenizer placeholder reading きごう ('kigou' = symbol) for the full-width space leaked into the phonetic transcription; きごう is not pronounced.
findings.current: でんしゃがとまったきごうそれでおくれた
findings.suggested: でんしゃがとまった　それでおくれた

findings.issue: Same leak in romaji: 'kigou' is an invented syllable string from the space-token placeholder, not punctuation left in (so not covered by the known issue).
母 refers to the speaker's own mother (the listener's mother would be お母さん); 'your mom' changes the referent.
Same referent error in pt: 母 é a mãe do próprio falante, não a do ouvinte; 'a sua mãe' inverte o referente.
findings.current: Alô, a mamãe está em casa?
findings.suggested: Alô, a mamãe está em casa? (ou 'a minha mãe') — nunca 'a sua mãe'

findings.issue: Teaches a false usage fact: claims 母 can be contextualized as 'your mother' depending on who asks. 母 always denotes the speaker's own mother; listener's mother is お母さん.
findings.current: in pt-BR we contextualize it as 'your mother' or 'the mother' depending on who is asking
findings.suggested: 母 (no honorific) is the speaker's own mother — 'my mom/Mom'; the listener's mother would be お母さん

findings.issue: Same false claim in pt: 母 não pode ser 'a sua mãe'; para a mãe do interlocutor usa-se お母さん.
findings.current: em pt-BR contextualizamos como 'a sua mãe' ou 'a mãe' conforme quem pergunta
findings.suggested: 母 (sem honorífico) é a mãe do próprio falante — 'minha mãe/a mamãe'; a mãe do ouvinte seria お母さん

findings.issue: 中ぐらい ('about average') is read ちゅうぐらい, not なかぐらい; in the grades sense 中 uses the on-reading ちゅう (cf. 中の上 ちゅうのじょう). Romaji 'naka' needs the same fix.
findings.current: せいせきわなかぐらいだった
findings.suggested: せいせきわちゅうぐらいだった

findings.issue: Token 中 in 中ぐらい should read ちゅう in this context (average level/rank), not なか.
Token array starts with stray duplicate tokens 食べ and すぎ (both null-glossed) before お菓子; token order no longer mirrors the sentence お菓子を少し食べすぎた.
findings.current: 食べ, すぎ (tokens[0]-[1], before お菓子)
findings.suggested: Delete tokens[0] and [1]; array should start with お, 菓子, を…

findings.issue: Reading for the full-width space token is the placeholder きごう ('symbol'); punctuation tokens elsewhere carry their own surface as r (e.g. 、).
Literal translation also misassigns 母 to the listener ('your mother').
findings.current: Hello, as for your mother, is she at home?
findings.suggested: Hello, as for (my) mother, is she at home?

findings.issue: Internal pipeline QA note leaked into the learner-facing explanation; learners never see a 'mechanical lemma ほす'. The correct fact (base = ほしい) is already stated earlier.
findings.current: (Note: the mechanical lemma 'ほす' is wrong; the real base is the adjective ほしい.)
findings.suggested: Delete this parenthetical (internal tokenizer remark, not learner content)

findings.issue: Same leaked internal QA note in the pt explanation.
findings.current: (Atenção: o lema mecânico 'ほす' está errado; a base real é o adjetivo ほしい.)
findings.suggested: Excluir este parêntese (nota interna do tokenizador, não é conteúdo didático)

findings.issue: Inaccurate mirror: を-marked object rendered as topic ('As for'), and concessive も of 〜てもいい rendered as additive 'too', which misreads the construction as 'may I also see'.
findings.current: As for the photo(s), is it permitted (for me) to look (humble) too?
findings.suggested: The photo(s) (obj.), even if (I) look (humbly), is it all right?

findings.issue: Same mis-mirror in pt: 'Quanto à(s)' trata を como tópico e 'também' lê o も concessivo como aditivo.
findings.current: Quanto à(s) foto(s), é permitido (eu) ver(humilde) também?
findings.suggested: A(s) foto(s) (obj.), mesmo que (eu) veja (humilde), está bem?

findings.issue: この means only 'this' (proximal); 'that' belongs to その/それ and is wrong in the English gloss (the pt gloss 'este, esse' is fine given BR colloquial usage).
Explanation misquotes the sentence as みんなが…, but the sentence omits が (みんなコートを着ている); a learner comparing them may think が is present or required.
findings.current: みんながコートを着ている (everyone is wearing a coat)
findings.suggested: みんなコートを着ている (everyone is wearing a coat)

findings.issue: Mesma citação incorreta na versão pt: a frase não tem が depois de みんな.
findings.current: みんながコートを着ている (todos estão de casaco)
findings.suggested: みんなコートを着ている (todos estão de casaco)
